description: This file defines an Android activity that demonstrates the use of Frame Buffer Object extension in OpenGL ES. It implements offscreen rendering into a framebuffer and displays the result as a texture on an onscreen scene, including inner classes for rendering logic and OpenGL ES setup.

classes.name: FrameBufferObjectActivity
classes.description: Main activity class that sets up GLSurfaceView with a custom Renderer to demonstrate framebuffer object rendering in OpenGL ES.

classes.name: Renderer
classes.description: Inner class implementing GLSurfaceView.Renderer, manages offscreen and onscreen rendering, framebuffer creation, and supports debugging options.

classes.name: Triangle
classes.description: Referenced within Renderer for drawing a triangle; implementation details not included in the snippet.

classes.name: Cube
classes.description: Referenced within Renderer for drawing a cube; implementation details not included in the snippet.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GLSurfaceView and assigns the Renderer.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes the GLSurfaceView rendering when activity resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses the GLSurfaceView rendering when activity is paused.

methods.name: checkGLError
methods.description: Checks for OpenGL errors and throws RuntimeException if errors are detected.

methods.name: createTargetTexture
methods.description: Generates and configures a texture used as a target for framebuffer rendering.

methods.name: createFrameBuffer
methods.description: Creates and sets up a framebuffer object with an attached depth buffer and color texture.

methods.name: checkIfContextSupportsFrameBufferObject
methods.description: Checks if the current OpenGL context supports framebuffer objects.

methods.name: checkIfContextSupportsExtension
methods.description: Checks if specific extension is supported in the current GL context.
